title: 第3章 人是铁，饭是钢-《穿越60带着空间当保安》
content:
第(1/3)页

    王野顺着棒子展开心神，看到水底有鱼，不过不多，都是一些不足巴掌大小的杂鱼。但泥里倒是有不一样的东西——泥鳅、黄鳝和鳖。

    鳖可是好东西呀！泥鳅和黄鳝差点儿意思，因为这东西费油。但到了这个地步，先活下去才有资格谈生活质量。

    只见王野拿着棒子在水里捅来捅去，捅一下就收一个，捅了半个小时，感觉脑袋有点晕，王野知道这是又到极限了。

    回到弟弟妹妹的树荫下，王野懒散地靠在树上：“江河，你看着点儿妹妹，我有点中暑，在这歇一会儿。”说完眯上了眼睛。

    心神进入空间，盘点刚才的收获。六只老鳖，大的得有三四斤，有三只，小的只有一斤多。还有七八十条泥鳅和黄鳝。

    眯了二三十分钟，感觉好点了，又来到河边，脱掉鞋子，挽起裤腿站在河边的淤泥里，不能去水深的地方。

    虽然王野前世就会游泳，但就现在的小体格，他感觉进水里不用十分钟就得抽筋。然后就等着躺板板吧。然后弯下腰把手放进水里，给人一种在水里摸东西的假象。

    有人就要问了，都收进空间里了，拿回家去吃就完了呗！同志们呀，不是咱想脱裤子放屁呀！王野的目标可是吃饱吃好活下去，这不明不白地带回家这么多东西，都不用进门，街道的就堵住你了。

    王野在得到空间时就下定决心。必须要把得到的东西，都有个来龙去脉。虽然不至于经得起侦探的调查，但总要让明面上的人觉得合情合理。

    不一会儿，王野双手拿出一条黄鳝走到岸上，在石头上摔死，兴奋地回头冲着弟弟喊：“江河，带着妹妹过来，看着这条黄鳝！”

    王江河牵着妹妹的手走了过来，问道：“大哥，你怎么抓了条蛇呀？”

    王野翻了个白眼：“傻小子，这是黄鳝，好吃着呢！好好看着别让人拿跑了！”

    王江河听到能吃，高声应道：“大哥放心吧！我一定看好了！”

    王野返回河里继续装模作样地摸着。一会儿一趟，一会儿一趟的，终于还是引起了路人的注意。

    一个穿着中山装的中年人说道：“小伙子，你这样不行呀！这些黄鳝泥鳅死了就换不了钱了。”

    现在有收购站，可以收购一些百姓手里的野味、药材之类的东西，虽然价格很低，但也有个正规渠道。

    王野无奈地摊手：“大爷，我也没办法呀！我也没有个容器，这东西活着，我弟弟妹妹可看不住它们。”

    中年人指着自己手里的鱼篓，说道：“小伙子，你看这样好不好？我用这个鱼篓跟你换点黄鳝行不？”

    王野看着鱼篓，心里想着缺什么来什么，嘴上倒也痛快：“行，你看你要几条合适。”

    中年人似是早就料到王野会同意：“现在收购站一斤黄鳝也就三毛钱，还得是活的，我也不占你便宜，我要你这些死的就行，反正回家就杀着吃了，我看着你这大的也就二三两一条，我要五条行不？”

    王野痛快答应：“行呀，我还得谢谢您呢！”

    三言两语两人就达成了交换条件。王野拿过鱼篓，中山装男子在一堆泥鳅黄鳝里挑了5条大点儿的。

    王野看这鱼篓，质量不错，一看就是正经篾匠编织的。

    看到大爷要走，王野叫道：“大爷，你等会儿。”

    中年人顿了一下，表情有些不淡定了：“怎么个事儿？爷们儿，这是要反悔呀？”

    王野连忙摆手：“哪能呢！我是看您这鱼篓质量这么好，觉得你有点儿亏了，这样，这点儿泥鳅您也拿着，怎么说也是点儿荤腥不是。”

    王野说完，拿起十来条泥鳅递给中年男人。

    中年人接过泥鳅，由衷地夸赞：“爷们儿一看就是四九城长大的孩子，局气！行，大爷也不跟你客气了，咱回见了。”说完中山装男子就走了。

    王野拿起鱼篓回到河里，继续装模作样地摸着。不到半小时就摸了多半鱼篓，这时围过来的人越来越多了，也有人有样学样地跟王野一起摸。

    王野也不管他们，总有人瞎猫碰到死耗子，总能摸上来几条，当王野从水里拿出一只四斤多重的老鳖时，岸上看热闹的人不淡定了。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Wang Ye followed the stick and opened his mind, and saw that there were fish at the bottom of the water, but there were not many, they were all miscellaneous fish less than the size of a palm.But there are different things in the mud - loaches, eels and turtles.

Turtles are a good thing!Loach and eel are almost boring because they consume fuel.But at this point, you have to survive first before you can talk about the quality of life.

I saw Wang Ye poking around in the water with a stick. After poking for half an hour, he felt a little dizzy. Wang Ye knew that he had reached his limit again.

Returning to the shade of his younger siblings, Wang Ye leaned against the tree lazily: "Jiang He, look at your sister, I'm suffering from heatstroke. Let's rest here for a while." After saying that, he narrowed his eyes.

Your mind enters the space and takes stock of what you have just gained.There were six old turtles, the big one weighed three or four kilograms, and there were three, and the small one only weighed more than one kilogram.There were also seventy or eighty loaches and eels.

After squinting for twenty or thirty minutes, I felt better. I went to the river again, took off my shoes, rolled up my trouser legs and stood in the mud by the river. I couldn't go to deep water.

Although Wang Ye knew how to swim in his previous life, with his current small body, he felt that he would get cramps within ten minutes after entering the water.Then just wait to lie down.Then he bent down and put his hand into the water, giving the illusion of touching something in the water.

Someone is about to ask, put it all into the space, take it home and eat it and that’s it!Comrades, it’s not like we want to take off our pants and fart!Wang Ye's goal is to eat well enough to survive. He brought home so many things for no reason, and he didn't even have to go in. People on the street would block him.

Wang Ye made up his mind when he got the space.There must be a context for everything you get.Although it may not withstand the investigation of detectives, it will always make people on the surface feel it is reasonable.

After a while, Wang Ye took out an eel with both hands and walked to the shore. He threw it to death on a stone. He excitedly turned around and shouted to his brother: "Jiang He, bring your sister over here and watch this eel!"

Wang Jianghe held his sister's hand and walked over and asked, "Brother, why did you catch a snake?"

Wang Ye rolled his eyes: "Silly boy, this is eel, it's delicious! Watch carefully and don't let anyone take it away!"

Wang Jianghe heard that he could eat it and responded loudly: "Brother, don't worry! I will definitely keep an eye on it!"

Wang Ye returned to the river and continued to pretend to touch it.He went there again and again, and finally caught the attention of passers-by.

A middle-aged man in Chinese tunic suit said: "Young man, you can't do this! These eels and loaches can't be exchanged for money if they die."

There are now purchase stations where you can buy some game, medicinal materials and other things from the hands of ordinary people. Although the prices are very low, there are also formal channels.

Wang Ye spread his hands helplessly: "Uncle, there's nothing I can do! I don't have a container either. These things are alive, and my younger brothers and sisters can't stand them."

The middle-aged man pointed to the fish basket in his hand and said, "Young man, do you think this is good? Can I trade this fish basket with you for some eels?"

Wang Ye looked at the fish basket, thinking about what was missing, and he said happily: "Okay, you can see how many fish you want."

The middle-aged man seemed to have expected that Wang Ye would agree: "Nowadays, a pound of eel at the buying station only costs 30 cents, and it has to be alive. I won't take advantage of you. I just want the dead ones. Anyway, I will kill them when I get home. I see that the big ones like you only cost two or three, so can I take five?"

Wang Ye readily agreed: "Okay, I have to thank you!"

In a few words, the two reached an exchange condition.Wang Ye took the fish basket, and the man in Mao suit picked five larger ones from a pile of loaches and eels.

Wang Ye saw that the fish basket was of good quality, and it looked like it was made by serious bamboo craftsmen.

Seeing that the uncle was about to leave, Wang Ye shouted: "Uncle, please wait a moment."

The middle-aged man paused for a moment, his expression a little uneasy: "What's the matter? Man, are you going to regret it?"

Wang Ye quickly waved his hand: "How can you not! I see that the quality of your fish basket is so good, I feel that you are a bit at a loss. If you take this little loach, it is not fishy after all."

After Wang Ye finished speaking, he picked up a dozen loaches and handed them to the middle-aged man.

The middle-aged man took the loach and praised it sincerely: "You look like a kid who grew up in Forty-Nine City. I'm so embarrassed! Okay, I won't be polite to you anymore. I'll see you later." After saying that, the man in Chinese tunic suit left.

Wang Ye picked up the fish basket and returned to the river, continuing to pretend to touch it.In less than half an hour, most of the fish baskets were touched. At this time, more and more people came around, and some people followed Wang Ye's example and touched them together.

Wang Ye didn't care about them. There was always a blind cat who encountered a dead mouse, and he could always touch a few. When Wang Ye took out an old turtle weighing four pounds from the water, the people watching the excitement on the shore became uneasy.
